key_path: Sign up at asana.com with Google/Microsoft OAuth or email (email signup sends verification link/code)
Complete onboarding (creates workspace/org and a first project)
Open developer console https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps > Create new token (PAT) with description
human_gates_notes: Admin approval only if MCP client app is blocked via app management (Enterprise+). For coding-client MCP, human must also create an OAuth app in the developer console (client id/secret, redirect URI) - no DCR.

agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: no for coding clients - docs: V2 server 'requires OAuth 2.0 authentication with a registered client ID and client secret' (well-known lists a /register endpoint, but docs say DCR unsupported; pre-registered for Claude/ChatGPT)
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - OAuth scopes (e.g. tasks:read); PATs are full-access
agent_native_auth.free_tier_or_sandbox: yes - Personal (free) plan; developer sandbox available on request

remote.url: https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp (beta v1 /sse still listed in Claude directory)
remote.auth: OAuth 2.0 with pre-registered client id+secret; no PAT bearer

mcp.local: none official; 'Command MCP Server' variant documented
mcp.one_click_install: no - per-client manual config with own OAuth app (Claude Code --client-id/--client-secret, Cursor env vars, Codex via mcp-remote --static-oauth-client-info)

docs_for_agents.llms_full_txt: https://developers.asana.com/llms-full.txt (returned 429 rate-limit; exists per readme.io pattern - unverified)

score_justification: PAT path is easy and docs are agent-readable, but MCP for coding agents requires hand-creating an OAuth app - no DCR, no PAT bearer.
best_practice: Markdown docs carry agentTools frontmatter pointing agents back to the llms.txt project index.
biggest_gap: MCP v2 forces users to register their own OAuth client (client id/secret + exact redirect URIs) for Claude Code/Cursor/VS Code/Codex.
